lines.zh: 我拿着锤子，走过打铁铺门口。
lines.en: I walk past the forge door with a hammer in hand.
My tool bag sways at my hip.
I walk slowly along the village road.

lines.zh: 我一边走一边摸刀的刃。
lines.en: I walk while feeling a blade's edge.

lines.zh: 我绕到屋子后面，看铁砧。
lines.en: I go round the back of the house to the anvil.
Iron filings cling to my soles.

lines.zh: 我走到柜台后面，摆正工具。
lines.en: I go behind the counter and straighten my tools.

lines.zh: 我提着热水，走得很小心。
lines.en: I carry hot water very carefully.

lines.zh: 我朝你那边走了两步，又停下。
lines.en: I take two steps your way and stop.

lines.zh: 我把袖子挽到肘上再走。
lines.en: I roll my sleeves to the elbow before walking.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方有一点焦味。
lines.en: There is a faint burnt smell where I pass.
I carry iron ingots and my steps are heavy.
I stand wiping my hands on my apron.

lines.zh: 我在看一把刚打好的刀。
lines.en: I am looking over a freshly forged blade.
I tuck the tongs under my arm.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听炉子里的声音。
lines.en: I listen to the sound from the furnace.
I am waiting for the iron to redden.

lines.zh: 我把磨刀石在手心里转了转。
lines.en: I turn the whetstone in my palm.
I look down at the old scars on my hands.
I count how many pieces I finished today.

lines.zh: 我把锤子往桌上一放，很轻。
lines.en: I set the hammer down lightly.
I watch the doorway and say nothing.

lines.zh: 我的围裙上有一块烧痕。
lines.en: There is a scorch on my apron.
The forge fire is just right for quenching.
I rub my hands and stand up straight.
I am thinking about which material to use.
Your sword is dull; let me see it.
What do you want made? Say it.
I do not repair other people's work.
The hand on that sword is soft.
Are you buying or learning?
I glance up at you without stopping my work.
Iron is more honest than people.
Your armour is due for replacement.
I know where that blade came from.
Stand back; sparks will fly.
This trade asks for patience.
Do not touch that one; it is still hot.
Let me show you the quality.
Good timing; it just came out of the fire.
Would you like to feel the weight?

lines.zh: 你的东西，值不了几块铁。
lines.en: Your item is worth only a few ingots.

lines.zh: 我做的东西，得对得起价钱。
lines.en: What I make must be worth its price.
I hand the blade over, hilt toward you.
I retreat behind the anvil.
That blow loosens my grip.
I shield my tools and say nothing.
I frown and keep standing.

lines.zh: 血滴在铁上，很快就干了。
lines.en: Blood drips on the iron and dries fast.
I hold the bench and steady myself.
Gritting my teeth, I raise my hand.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了我手上的活。
lines.en: That interrupted my work.

lines.zh: 我看了看伤口，估了估深浅。
lines.en: I look at the wound and judge its depth.
I grip the hammer tighter.
You brought iron? Put it here.
That material is good; let me see.
Do you have coal? I am short of it.
Lay your things on the counter.
That old blade; I will make an offer.

lines.zh: 你手里的皮子，能做个柄。
lines.en: That hide of yours could make a grip.
Bring your armour; I will adjust it.
The fire is bright enough for me to see.
This quality is worth taking.
Add a little more and I will agree.

lines.zh: 你撞到我，我手里的钳子掉了。
lines.en: You bump me and my tongs fall.
I step back and shield the counter.

lines.zh: 我们擦过，我的围裙蹭到你。
lines.en: We brush past and my apron grazes you.

lines.zh: 我被撞得一歪，锤子也斜了。
lines.en: Knocked askew, my hammer tilts too.

lines.zh: 你撞在铁砧上，声音很响。
lines.en: You strike the anvil with a loud clang.

lines.zh: 我抬手挡了一下，手心很硬。
lines.en: I raise a hand to block, palm hard.
After the bump, I pick up my tools first.
Do not crowd me; everything here has an edge.
I push you out, afraid you will burn yourself.
We part and I go wash my hands.
In my trade we speak only of craft.
I have a furnace and iron; that is enough.
You ask at a poor time.

lines.zh: 我的手太粗，不适合这些。
lines.en: My hands are too rough for such things.
I set the hammer down.

lines.zh: 你换个问题，我还有个活要干。
lines.en: Ask something else; I have work to finish.
I am no good at such things.
I smile once and shake my head.
I only beat iron into shape.
Off you go; I need to light the forge.
I pinch it up and check the edge.
Edge down, I weigh it in my hand.
I lift the iron with tongs.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的钉子，我都收。
lines.en: I keep every nail that falls.
I pick it up and weigh it in my hand.
This is still usable; do not throw it out.
I put it back on the tool rack.

lines.zh: 我拾起你的刀，看了一眼。
lines.en: I pick up your blade and glance at it.

lines.zh: 我捡起来，递给旁边的人。
lines.en: I pick it up and hand it to the one beside me.
This piece is too thin to be useful.
Bring the thing over here.
I have my eye on that material of yours.
Stand still; let me see your hands.
I will take this job.
I look up, straight at you.
That item of yours is worth a talk.
I set the hammer aside.

lines.zh: 你腰上那把，拿来我看看。
lines.en: That blade at your belt — let me see it.
The target is this one with the sword.

lines.zh: 我朝柜台那头偏了一下头。
lines.en: I tilt my head toward the counter.
I need to handle your item.
I slow down and watch your hands.
I will do this piece myself.
You are on my work list.
I take up a pen and make a note.
No hurry; first take measurements.
I watch you while honing a blade.
Your job is not done; I remember.

lines.zh: 你把东西拿走，我就看着。
lines.en: Take your item, and I will be watching.
I look up, and you are still standing there.
Your hands move, and I see it clearly.
I wait for you to bring it out yourself.

lines.zh: 你走近柜台，我就在这儿。
lines.en: You come to the counter, and I am here.

lines.zh: 我把铁翻了个面，继续看。
lines.en: I turn the iron over and keep watching.
I have not finished your price.
I stay by the furnace.

lines.zh: 你走开两步，我还看着你。
lines.en: You step two paces off, and I still watch.
I keep you in sight.

lines.zh: 你绕到窗边，我抬头就看见。
lines.en: You go by the window and I see you at once.
Your hand has not left your bag.
You linger at the doorway; I am counting.
You put the thing down and pick it up again.

lines.zh: 我不出声，只看着你的手。
lines.en: I make no sound, only watch your hands.
I will see this job through.
I block you with the hammer.

lines.zh: 钳子夹住你的袖子，扯开。
lines.en: The tongs catch your sleeve and pull.
That blow came from the tongs.
I shove you out the doorway.
I catch your wrist, and my grip is hard.
You are shoved into the counter.
I raise my palm, still sparking.

lines.zh: 这一推，是让你离铁砧远点。
lines.en: That shove was to keep you off the anvil.

lines.zh: 你碰了那块热铁，不怪我。
lines.en: You touched the hot iron; not my fault.
I keep you away from the anvil.
I shoulder you aside.
I block with my tool bag.
I push you away from the anvil.
That blow smelled of rust.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领，拽了一下。
lines.en: I take your collar and pull.
The hammer drops; you back away.

lines.zh: 我从炉边站起来，擦了擦手。
lines.en: I rise from the furnace and wipe my hands.
You hear hammer blows first.
I push the door open with iron dust on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 我站在柜台后面，一直在。
lines.en: I stand behind the counter; I have been here.

lines.zh: 我把护目镜推到额头上。
lines.en: I push my goggles up onto my forehead.

lines.zh: 我从屋里走出来，围裙还系着。
lines.en: I come out of the shop, apron still on.

lines.zh: 炉火一亮，我的脸就出来了。
lines.en: The forge flares and my face appears.

lines.zh: 我端着工具盒走到门口。
lines.en: I carry my tool box to the doorway.

lines.zh: 锤子还握在手里，我抬头。
lines.en: Hammer still in hand, I look up.

lines.zh: 我这摊子上，也卖捕虫网。
lines.en: I sell bug nets at this stall too.
I set down the blade blank.

lines.zh: 我在门口挂上营业的牌子。
lines.en: I hang the open sign at the door.
I come out from the back room.

lines.zh: 炉里的火刚点上，我就在。
lines.en: The forge is just lit, and I am there.

lines.zh: 我拎着两把刀站在门口。
lines.en: I stand at the door holding two blades.
I stop and look at your hands.

lines.zh: 我从窗子后面望了你一眼。
lines.en: I glance at you from behind the window.
I lift the door curtain and step out.

lines.zh: 我手上沾了火，甩了两下。
lines.en: Fire catches my hand and I shake it twice.

lines.zh: 我从架子上摔下，工具落了一地。
lines.en: I fall off the shelf and tools scatter.

lines.zh: 水进了我的口鼻，我抓住桶边。
lines.en: Water fills my mouth and I grab the barrel edge.

lines.zh: 气浪把柜台的刀全都震落。
lines.en: The blast shakes every blade off the counter.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进了我的工具架。
lines.en: An arrow thuds into my tool rack.

lines.zh: 法术扫过，铁都变得发蓝。
lines.en: A spell passes and the iron turns blue.

lines.zh: 忙了一天没吃东西，手在抖。
lines.en: A whole day without food, and my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，炉火都跳了一下。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the forge fire leaps.

lines.zh: 虚空扯我，我抓着铁砧腿。
lines.en: The void pulls me and I grip the anvil's leg.
